# Step 2.249: `new-season-test` fails from the league's midnight (small-fix helper)

**The cause: the test, not the product.** `new-season-test` started the made-up world on the machine's real clock (no `LOCAL_NOW`). Its check "the owner finds a decided game to correct" needs a decided Fall 2026 game on Admin → Games' default view (Needs a result, Today, this week). The only decided games near today are the two the seed dates from the world's now (`fromNow: -120` and `-180`, stand-in-world-seed.ts). From the league's midnight (America/Chicago, 06:00 UTC in winter) to 03:00, those fall on last night, so they are under Earlier games, shown one round at a time on request (step 2.156). The screen listed no decided game and the check timed out. Reproduced here at 06:5x UTC: the same 60 s timeout.

**Not a product fault.** A real league's admin at 00:30 finds yesterday's decided game under Earlier games, by its round, which is how the screen is meant to work (list-earlier-games.ts). Games before the league's today are never on Today.

**What changed.**

- `tests/browser/new-season-test.mjs`: starts the world with `LOCAL_NOW: worldAtNoon()` (scripts/league-clock.mjs, T-404), as `games-area-test` does. Nothing it checks was loosened.
- `tests/world-at-noon.test.mjs` (new, runs in `npm test`): pretends the machine's clock (node:test `mock.timers`, Date only) every three hours in UTC and in the league's zone, and at -5, -1, 0, +1, +5 and +59 minutes around both midnights, on 2026-11-25 (UTC-6) and 2026-07-15 (UTC-5). Each time `worldAtNoon()` must give 12:00 in the league's zone on the league's today, and the seed made at that moment must hold a decided current-season game dated that today and already played.
- Pending decision `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/T-425.md`. No spec file names T-404's rule, so no spec change. No migration.

**Broken by hand.** `worldAtNoon` changed to 00:30: the test fails ("'00:30' !== '12:00'"). Both of the seed's `fromNow` decided games moved to -800 minutes: it fails "no decided game today" (machine 2026-07-14T23:55Z). Both put back.

**Siblings (item 4).** Searched `tests/browser/*.mjs` and `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` for dates made from the machine's now. None needed a one-line fix:

- `fixture-import`, `reschedule`, `rounds`, `season-settings`, `season-shown`: `worldNow = new Date()` with no `LOCAL_NOW`. The world uses the same clock and the dates go through `leagueDay`, so they agree (step 2.246).
- `bad-wifi-visitors-test.mjs:291`: "left yesterday" is UTC yesterday. From 00:00 to 06:00 UTC it is the league's today. That is allowed (not after today), so it cannot fail, but `leagueDay(..., -1)` would say what is meant. Not changed: it needs an import as well as the line.
- `admin-teams-on-database-test.mjs:69`: today in Chicago, written in the test. Right, but it names the zone itself.
- `people-screens`, `first-child`, `undo-removing`: birth and future years from the machine's UTC year, years away from any edge.
- `check-web-shell.mjs`: nothing, since it already pins noon.

**What ran, and passed.** `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run format:check` all passed. `npm test`: 434 of 434. `npm run test:web`: 288 checks. One browser chunk at 06:54 UTC, which is 00:54 in Chicago, inside the hours that failed before: `new-season-test` (46 checks), `games-area-test` (38), `after-midnight-test` (5) and `needs-result-test` (33).

**Distrust.** Other browser tests that start the world on the machine's clock and lean on a `fromNow` game were not run at 00:00 to 03:00 Chicago. The grep looked for dates, not for that kind of lean.
